snippet.title: Rowen's Grand Adventure Trailer
snippet.description:
This is a trailer announcing the release of my latest game.

It's out now on both GameJolt and Itchio, with a Steam release planned sometime next month (or the month after, depending on how things go).
GameJolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/RGA/1015930
Itchio: https://danvzare.itch.io/rga

If you're at all interested, give the pages a look to find out more information.
I'm currently selling the game for £9.99 (which is around $13)
But if that's too much for you, I've got plenty of games on my GameJolt and Itchio profiles that I've made for free.
